finalText:
**Big, but mostly mechanical.** 1082 hits across 94 files. Roughly 900+ are internal repo/service code (`services/*`, columns, params) — safe to rename with a normal migration.

Four spots must keep `account_id` exactly:

| Location | Why |
|---|---|
| `[docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml)` | public API contract, frozen field name and query param |
| `[lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8)` | wire-format map, public JSON key clients read |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/*` | vendored, overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh` |
| `migrations/*.sql` (applied ones, e.g. `[20250624_backfill_account_ids.sql](migrations/20250624_backfill_account_ids.sql)`) | already run in prod, history, editing breaks the down step |

`lib/audit.js` also keys on `account_id` for audit lines — check with platform team before touching, likely same "frozen history" rule.

Next: rename internal DB columns and code via a new migration, keep the `WIRE` map and OpenAPI spec untouched.
